## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与变化

Describe the user-visible problem, the trigger and the resulting behavior.

## Validation / 验证

List the checks actually completed, their results, and any untested behavior.

- [ ] Relevant documentation and links are updated.
- [ ] No recordings, runtime logs, credentials or signed stream URLs are included.
- [ ] Python recording changes were checked with actual FFmpeg process behavior, if applicable.
- [ ] Any native binary change includes its source and a reproducible build procedure, if applicable.
